altbuild: none: pip-wrapped Python package, one pinned wheel image.

comparison.rule: Every sorted eigenvalue of H is graded pointwise, |c-r|<=atol+rtol|r|; nothing excluded.

configuration: spinful_fermion_basis_general(4x4 torus, Nf=(2,2), simple_symm=False, kx,ky,s 'advanced' symmetry convention); H=hopping(J)+n(mu)+nn(U); full sorted spectrum.
default_vs_upstream: Graded as-is; upstream already diagonalises H and this keeps its default Lx=Ly=4, Nf=(2,2). Shares the same physical model (same J, U, mu, Nf, lattice) and hence the same spectrum with doc-spinful-fermion-basis-general-simple, reached via the 'advanced' rather than 'simple' symmetry-transformation convention -- a distinct documented deck grading the same physics by design, noted here and in that check's README.

evidence.floor_how: no alternative build; the nominal/variant self-validation measures the spread

observable: spectrum: the full sorted eigenvalue spectrum of H.
variant: The hopping strength J changes from J=1.0 to J*(1+1e-13) (relative 1e-13); J multiplies the off-diagonal hopping terms (the onsite potential and interaction are diagonal in the Fock basis).
warrant: A wrong 'advanced' symmetry-map construction, fermion sign convention or eigensolver changes the spectrum far beyond the measured bound; a correct but differently-ordered summation stays inside it -- the active-J variant supplies the calibration evidence.
